answer: Emission per identity starts as a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 17 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 529 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The dune test is the live device, the spiral test is the locked stake, and the knoll test is the graded history no template can fake.
